title: Implement host-global bridge-to-Lua pending-call/result correlation registry

evidence: timer object stores duration seconds and nanoseconds separately

implementation.pendingCount: exact dictionary length of outstanding bridge-to-Lua calls
implementation.commandIds: monotonic cmd_<n> using an explicit initial counter seed
implementation.correlation: payload.id; outer requestId equality remains deliberately unasserted
implementation.authenticatedRouteBinding: profileId + instanceId must match the authenticated session owning the pending call
implementation.success: remove pending entry and complete with cloned result JSON
implementation.luaFailure: remove pending entry and complete with LUA_CALL_FAILED
implementation.timeout: remove pending entry and complete with LUA_CALL_TIMEOUT after 200 ms
implementation.shutdown: atomically drain all entries with APP_SHUTTING_DOWN / application is shutting down

nextExactGap: Implement framed authenticated-session write/read transport using the recovered outbound/inbound queue and byte limits, encode pending calls as command/call frames, parse inbound result frames, and complete this registry from the authenticated route. Keep normal application composition disabled until the transport is Windows-proven.
